dataset.name: Bharatanatyam Mudra Dataset Master BM
dataset.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (as stated in the downloaded archive LICENSE.md)
dataset.count_note: Counts are regenerated by evaluation_module/data_prep/validate_dataset.py --update-mapping; archive folder counts exclude unsupported non-image files.

mapping_policy: Each exact source folder label maps independently to a stable catalogue ID. The (1) suffix is retained in dataset_folder as part of the source label. Katakamukha_1/2/3 remain separate source classes and variant identifiers, mapped to their shared root mudra only; this is an explicit dataset taxonomy decision based on the source's three named variants and reviewed sample images.
